Feed.author: Merritt Nelson
Feed.content: I am deeply interested in our community’s programs and organized planning. Maintaining a healthy economic condition for the future of Sparta Township is my top priority.

Feed.author: Bob Zimdar
Feed.content: I am so proud to announce that our Sparta Ben Franklin store is participating in our parent company’s 100th birthday celebration! We’ll be offering a year-long series of outstanding specials each week throughout 1977.

Feed.author: Bob Zimdar
Feed.content: The Ben Franklin story really fulfills the American dream. As an independent franchisee, I love serving this community in partnership with such a historic organization.

Feed.author: Bob Zimdar
Feed.content: Did you know Ben Franklin started as a tiny wholesale business called Butler Brothers in 1877? They pioneered the '5-and-10 Cent Store' concept that we all know and love today.

Feed.author: Joie Thomas
Feed.content: I can’t wait to see all the little ones for Pre-School Activity Time starting January 18th! We’re going to have so much fun with music, art, and story time at Clover Street School.

Feed.author: Laura Crouch
Feed.content: Calling all artists! My County Painting class for beginners and intermediate students starts January 27th at the High School. I hope to see you there on Thursday evenings!
